description: The path on the ground below an Earth satellite over one or two orbits: a list of points (time, latitude, longitude, height) and a GeoJSON MultiLineString split at the antimeridian, ready for a map. Up to 360 points.

id.description: Object id from perigee_find (NORAD number, mission id, planet, "moon:<id>", "site:<id>", "launch:<id>", "star:<id>", "comet:<id>", "asteroid:<id>" or a dwarf planet name), e.g. "25544" for the ISS.

lang.description: Language of names and texts (default en).

name: perigee_ground_track
title: Ground track
